subject: VertexResell addendum - pass-through allocation and liability escalation
messages:
From: Juan Garcia <juan@vertexresell.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@vertexresell.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: VertexResell reseller addendum - redlines and pass-through allocation

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Attaching our initial redlines to the reseller/marketplace addendum. Two quick asks up front:
1) We need explicit pass-through for marketplace levies and reseller-collected taxes (we cant carry that exposure in our P&L).
2) Carveout on indemnity tied to reseller-managed customer onboarding (we operate the marketplace listing and control subscription flow).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept this language or if you need a legal/ops call? Wed prefer to close redlines this week to keep the Q1 listing timeline.

Attachments: Vertex_Reseller_Addendum_v2_redlines.docx, VR_addendum_comment_log.pdf

Thanks,
Juan
Juan Garcia
Head of Partnerships, VertexResell
juan@vertexresell.com

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Juan Garcia <juan@vertexresell.com>, contracts@vertexresell.com
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VertexResell reseller addendum - redlines and pass-through allocation

Thanks Juan — we got the doc. Looping in Karthik (sales lead) and Mina (rev ops) so we can align on commercial / billing flows before Marissa (legal) gives a formal take.

Top priorities from our side:
- Clear definition: what counts as a "pass-through" charge vs a Redwood fee (marketplace listing, payment processor fees, taxes).
- Invoice flow: Vertex wants marketplace fees to be invoiced to them by Redwood vs pass-through on their invoices; need to understand cashflow impact.
- Liability carveout: we need to be careful with indemnity language that would leave Redwood exposed for core runtime/service outages.

Can we do a 30-minute triage call tomorrow 2/20? Proposed agenda: 1) confirm pass-through buckets, 2) suggest alternate carveout language, 3) ops steps to support listing.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Juan Garcia <juan@vertexresell.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VertexResell reseller addendum - redlines and pass-through allocation

Quick POV from sales ops:
- Resellers typically expect to pass marketplace platform fees and collected sales taxes. If we insist on holding that, well lose margin or need to adjust list price.
- Suggested trade: accept pass-through for taxes and marketplace levies if Vertex agrees to a non-refundable onboarding credit (one-time) and a minimum listing commitment for 12 months.
- We should avoid any language that requires Redwood to "guarantee" third-party marketplace uptime. Instead, offer a service level for Redwoods API/hosting and a separate advisory clause re: marketplace availability.

Ill be on the triage call and can share template redline language for the commercial tradeoffs.

— Karthik

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Juan Garcia <juan@vertexresell.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>, contracts@vertexresell.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VertexResell reseller addendum - redlines and pass-through allocation

Hi all — thanks for the context. I reviewed the redlines and prepared a short set of alternative language (attached: proposed_pass_through_language.docx) that tries to balance Vertexs ask with Redwoods enterprise risk profile. Key points:

1) Pass-Through Charges: We can accept pass-through of taxes and marketplace levies that Vertex demonstrably remits on its invoices, provided Vertex indemnifies Redwood solely for collector-level tax liabilities and not for Redwoods own tax obligations. Proposed clause: "Reseller shall be responsible for all taxes and marketplace levies imposed on transactions collected through Resellers marketplace listing, provided Reseller furnishes reasonable evidence of remittance."

2) Indemnity Carveout: We will not accept broad indemnity transfer for Redwood infrastructure outages. Proposed carveout: "Resellers indemnification obligations shall not apply to losses resulting from Redwoods failure to meet its SLA for the hosted inference service, except where such failure directly results from Resellers gross negligence or willful misconduct."

3) Billing Flow Options: Two options provided — (A) Redwood invoices marketplace fees to Reseller monthly (pass-through accounting, Redwood acts as remitting agent), or (B) Vertex invoices the end customer and remits marketplace fees to Redwood with stated timing. Option A is operationally simpler for Vertex but requires a short implementation on our billing side.

Please see the attached redline doc for exact language. If Vertex accepts bullet points 1/2, we can prepare a final addendum for countersign. If not, flag the specific lines to escalate to legal ops.

On Fri, Feb 19, 2027 at 12:18 PM karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick POV from sales ops:
> - Resellers typically expect to pass marketplace platform fees and collected sales taxes...

Attachments: proposed_pass_through_language.docx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: contracts@vertexresell.com
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Juan Garcia <juan@vertexresell.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VertexResell reseller addendum - pass-through allocation and liability escalation

Marissa / team,

Thanks — receiving the proposed language is helpful. A few notes from procurement/legal at VertexResell:
- The proposed "evidence of remittance" phrasing is acceptable but well need a specific list of acceptable documents (tax receipts, filing references, marketplace settlement reports).
- The indemnity carveout is understandable; however, Vertex requests an explicit cross-reference to marketplace listing responsibilities so theres no ambiguity on who controls customer onboarding.
- Procurement requests a 14-day review to confirm internal accounting for the billing flow option (Option A vs Option B).

We can proceed with the following next steps: 1) Vertex to circulate a short doc with acceptable remittance evidence examples, 2) Redwood to produce a DocuSign-ready addendum after finalizing the exact pass-through wording, 3) schedule a closing call w/ legal ops on 3/4 if needed.

Attachments: VR_addendum_comment_log.pdf (with internal notes)

Best,
Vertex Resell Contracts Team
contracts@vertexresell.com
summary: Partner (VertexResell) submitted redlines seeking broad pass-through of marketplace fees and a carveout on indemnity. Redwood team (Vivek, Marissa, Karthik, Mina) proposed balanced language, two billing flow options, and asked for evidence of remittance. Vertex requested clarification on acceptable remittance docs and 14-day procurement review; next steps: finalize wording and prepare DocuSign addendum.
